'''Beach Rose Town''' (Japanese: '''ハマナスタウン''' ''Hamanasu Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Sinnoh]]. Like many other {{cat|towns}} in the [[region]], Beach Rose has its own [[Contest Hall]], which makes it a popular destination among [[Pokémon Coordinator]]s who plan on entering the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]].

A [[Pokémon Contest]] was held in Beach Rose Town, the result of which was reported during [[Marian]]'s [[television]] show in ''[[DP106|A Breed Stampede!]]''. [[Nando]] was revealed to have won the competition with the help of his {{TP|Nando|Kricketune}}, earning his fourth [[Ribbon]].
